project.name: chopped-by-diego
project.productType: one-page local-service site (solo barber, Northwest Houston) — phone-first, Booksy inline booking

colors.rules: cream is the ink of the page; signal is punctuation only — NEVER a button fill (Oryzo rule); warm walnut canvas, never pure black; hairlines carve layout (Hyperstudio)

typography.display: Bricolage Grotesque (variable: opsz 12..96, wdth 75..100, wght 300..600) — weight 300–500, negative tracking, oversized; the name WHISPERS
typography.quote: Newsreader italic 300 (opsz axis) — one italic line per screen max, his words only
typography.mono: Azeret Mono 400/500 — every label, duration, price, caption, mast (the third voice)

spacing.rhythm: off-grid (14/22/34), generous void above the fold ≥40%

radius.policy: committed sharp for surfaces; pills only for buttons

shadows.policy: none — depth by hairline, grain, vignette

motion.signature: variable-font weight/width breathing on the name; hairlines draw on; mask reveals; contextual cursor label; freehand-line SVG preloader

design.density: editorial — one idea per screen on phone

preferredPrimitives: outlined cream pill button with corner-bracket draw-on (21st Motion Button / Dot Border Button mechanics)
hairline rate rows with mono numerals
void-mode photo plate with mono caption
patterns: Booksy inline widget (mode=inline, id 1668896) as the silent last section

must: all copy in Diego's own voice
real photos only — 22 assets in hand, no stock, no AI imagery, no Higgsfield
ONE conversion verb wired to Booksy
divergence contact-sheet run vs AJR/Sleek/Rigos before any render is shown
every component sourced from 21st.dev first (mechanism), rebuilt on our clock + tokens
avoid: tracked 11px uppercase eyebrows below readable size

decisions.decision: first screen sells MASTERY (prodigy; 'make you look better, become better')
NO before/after scrub — vetoed as AI slop
NO singular hero object; smooth subtle motion distributed through the site
DARK site; warm walnut recipe
frame one = him working (photo 02) + 'DIEGO SANDOVAL' lockup; 07 = second island
sub-line = 'Being a barber isn't just cutting hair.' Tagline closes the page; 'I get paid to make people look good' opens the gallery
v2 darkroom register LOCKED — Bricolage Grotesque · Newsreader · Azeret Mono; outlined bracket pills; accent as punctuation. v1 rejected: clustered with AJR/Sleek on the divergence sheet
scroll order LOCKED: preloader → name (02) → the work (10·06·04·08·03 editorial track) → the chair (07 + 3 named Booksy quotes) → rate card → book (tagline + Booksy inline). Work before price.

gallery = 'the darkroom': sticky print stack (21st 18979) + scrubbed mask bloom (21st 10905) + plate→print develop; 4:5 crops with one grade; void by vignette, NO hair knockout; rail numeral + hairline progress. Passed divergence sheet.
preloader = ornamental nape (10) traced as ONE continuous cream line, simple; gates on fonts + hero decode
the chair = 07 island + 3 Booksy quotes, scroll-band focus (21st 26548) + one long review lit word-by-word (21st 9386)
rate card = blade-guard ladder: mono guard numerals, rows light in sequence, digits roll; current Booksy prices; no SaaS pricing card
EN/ES segmented toggle in the sticky mast (21st 23552 masked-thumb mechanic); quotes untranslated; ?lang=es deep-link
v2 revision: display face = Bodoni Moda (opsz 96, italic accents); Fraunces rejected by the detector as an AI-convergence face; Newsreader dropped; Bricolage body + Azeret Mono labels kept

Biography beat after the hero: 'More than a job. It's a passion.' + placeholder bio (Diego's words to replace) + two-column counter-drift showcase of 02/05/07/03 (21st 1224 parallax columns + 20039 tilt-in), then the tools
Gallery = staggered two-column prints (21st 7845 unfold-on-arrival) + tap lightbox (21st 26223); no sticky/forced scroll; captions under the print, stagger is deliberate
Rate card = rounded chips, one open at a time (21st 9602 mechanism), price in Bodoni 26px outranks the label; blade-guard glyphs removed

Crossings: hand-drawn SVG scissors/clipper travel a wave path between beats via GSAP MotionPathPlugin, scrubbed, leaving a dotted cut line; halves rotate via the SVG transform attribute (no transform-origin ambiguity)
Every headline/quote/paragraph arrives through per-word slots (yPercent 112 + skewY 4 → 0, expo.out, stagger capped so a paragraph never takes over ~1s); split is idempotent across EN/ES swaps

v3 decompression on the 4-seat council's numbers: --beat 104px between beats, single-column prints (92% width, alternating 8% offset), display 46-56px / body 17px at 1.62, one label per section (section eyebrows removed), third 'See open times' pill removed
Hero: two bounded transform-only scroll layers (plate +32px, lockup -12px, caption fades) on top of the load push-in (img 1.12->1, 2.6s); no three-layer parallax (xAI: it will jank on his phone)

Biography = darkroom shutter (07 full-width; two walnut blades scaleY 1->0 on scroll, 21st 9326 mechanism) + fanned pair (02 detail, 03 event; xPercent/rotation converge, 21st 24669). The gold clipper 05 returns to the tools beat at full width (Study C)

Gallery = the blade draws the portfolio: dotted cut line scaleX 0->1 with a scissors marker riding it, print clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0)->0 in its wake (21st 10905), gold viewfinder corners in the eye band, tap lightbox kept

Reviews lead with 4.9 (Bodoni 72px) + '54 reviews · Booksy' link; quote blur 1.2px / floor .62 so proof stays readable; sticky 'Book' pill after the fold, hidden on the booking beat; rendered gold clipper (SVG, gradients) replaces the line drawing in the crossings

Client (Diego) loves v3; owner directs an Apple idiom for controls on top of the locked darkroom register: --apple cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1) for controls, radius tokens (--r-print 18, --r-chip 22, pills 999), sentence-case Bricolage on buttons, corner brackets + gold dot removed

Materials: primary = filled cream pill; secondary/sticky/lightbox close = liquid glass (translucent fill + backdrop blur + mask-composite hairline brighter at the top edge, 21st 12460 idea without the displacement map); rate rows = glass chips, plus centred on its own positioned box (the off-centre bug was pseudo-elements positioned against the row)

Rendered gold clipper REMOVED at the owner's request (looked wrong); scissors crossings stay (2). Photos take over the motion: prints tilt in (rotateX 9->0) with the cut-wipe; tapping a print flies the print itself into the lightbox and back (shared element, 21st 11979 mechanism, GSAP FLIP by hand)

Owner overrules the council on glass: 'more liquid glass, an integrated website in the Apple ecosystem'. Astra spec adopted: 3-level glass (bar rgba(32,22,16,.72)/blur20/sat140 · card rgba(43,29,20,.78)/blur16/sat125 · pill rgba(28,19,13,.68)/blur12/sat150), shared hairline .16 + top highlight + inner/outer shadow; primary pill stays solid cream 52px

Gallery = full-page prints (fr height 88.5vh, 12px inset, radius 24, glass caption pill), each settling scale 1.045->1 / y 20->0 / clip 3%->0; the Houston event photo opens the gallery full-bleed 390x844 (the biggest image on the page); the cutting-action shot becomes the biography inset
Testimonials: 4.9 at 76px + glass source pill; one glass card with the three quotes (band-focus kept), a second with the word-lit long review (floor .62); cards enter y 20 / scale .985

Two detailed line-drawn shears (Opus subagent, 5 render passes): plain Japanese shear on a solid cut line (hero->bio), thinning shear with 14 teeth on a dashed cut line (gallery->chair); halves pivot at the origin, three snips per crossing; assets/shear.svg + thinning.svg
